req.title: Create new player
req.statement: The system shall create a player and respond with HTTP 201 when POST /players/ receives a valid Player payload.
expected_outcomes: Location header points to new resource

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a valid player creation request should result in a 201 Created response with a Location header pointing to the new resource. Tests should cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_player_success
preconditions: The player with squad number 10 does not exist in the database.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a valid PlayerRequestModel payload.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Lionel",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Messi",
    "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.post("/players/", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.headers["Location"] == "/players/squadnumber/10"

tests.name: test_create_player_conflict
preconditions: A player with squad number 10 already exists in the database.
actions: Send a POST request to /players/ with a PlayerRequestModel payload having squad number 10.
expected: The response contains a conflict error message.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Lionel",
    "middleName": "",
    "lastName": "Messi",
    "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Forward",
    "abbrPosition": "FW",
    "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": True
}

# First, create the player to ensure conflict
client.post("/players/", json=player_data)

# Attempt to create the same player again
response = client.post("/players/", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 409
assert "A Player with this squad number already exists." in response.json()["detail"]
